name: Valley of Love
kicker: Landscaped valley park north of town
summary: Valley of Love is a paid landscaped park north of the centre, not a wild forest. Walk the paths for 1 to 2 hours. Hours are about 07:00 to 17:00. The gate price is Check on arrival. A 2025 secondary article prints about 250,000 VND.
heroCaption: Flower slopes in the Valley of Love

notice.title: This is a paid park
notice.body: The valley is landscaped. The gate price is Check on arrival. A 2025 secondary article prints about 250,000 VND. Do not expect an open hillside outside a fence.

body: The park north of town is a landscaped valley: paths, planted slopes, and a managed walk. Plan 1 to 2 hours. It is not a trail outside a fence.
Hours are about 07:00 to 17:00. The settled price is Check on arrival. A 2025 secondary article prints about 250,000 VND. Pay the figure the gate asks. The taxi north has no printed minutes.

figures.caption: The stone name slope in the park
figures.alt: Stone slope with the park name at the Valley of Love

gettingThere: The park is north of the centre. Take a taxi from Xuan Huong Lake. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi north. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: The settled adult price is Check on arrival. A 2025 secondary article prints about 250,000 VND. Visit Lâm Đồng hours are about 07:00 to 17:00. Confirm the ticket at the gate.
